InputReceipt.description:
Ephemeral receipt in session-epoch RAM only. No input bytes or keystroke hash.
Acceptance counts PTY bytes; it does not mean shell execution or permit replay.

OperationLookup.description: Status lookup route within the authenticated workspace channel. Never a URL.

OperationReceipt.description:
Validated receipt DTO, not proof of persistence, admission, authority or fencing.
A consumer must authenticate current rights and row binding before disclosure.

OperationResult.description: Only identifiers/revisions, no names, paths, commands or cached plaintext.

TerminalLayout.description: The shared terminal projection contains no private desktop view descriptors.

WorkingDirectoryValue.description: An absolute Host path or null when unknown
